symptoms: Payment requests were failing and API response time increased.
root_cause: Database connection pool was exhausted during a traffic spike.
resolution: Increased database connection pool size from 50 to 100.

symptoms: Users were unable to log in and authentication latency increased.
root_cause: Redis cache became unavailable and authentication requests overloaded the database.
resolution: Restarted Redis and enabled connection fallback to the database.

symptoms: Customers received errors when placing orders.
root_cause: Database deadlocks occurred because multiple transactions updated the same records.
resolution: Optimized transaction ordering and added retry logic for deadlocks.

symptoms: Email and SMS notifications were arriving several minutes late.
root_cause: Message queue backlog increased because notification workers were under-provisioned.
resolution: Increased the number of notification workers from 3 to 8.

symptoms: Payment requests intermittently failed during peak traffic.
root_cause: Database connection pool reached its maximum limit.
resolution: Increased connection pool size and optimized long-running database queries.

root_cause: Search cluster nodes were overloaded due to high query volume.
resolution: Added another search node and redistributed the query workload.

symptoms: Profile pages took more than 10 seconds to load.
root_cause: A missing database index caused full table scans.
resolution: Added an index to the frequently queried user_id column.

symptoms: Some payments failed while others succeeded.
root_cause: An upstream payment gateway was experiencing increased latency.
resolution: Enabled retry with exponential backoff and temporarily routed traffic through a secondary gateway.

symptoms: Product stock counts were not updating immediately after purchases.
root_cause: Inventory events were stuck in the message queue.
resolution: Restarted failed consumers and increased consumer concurrency.

symptoms: Customers could not place any orders.
root_cause: A database migration locked a critical orders table.
resolution: Rolled back the migration and rescheduled it during a maintenance window.
